title: Gold(I) and gold(III) complexes of triazolyl-functionalised NHCs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18123-18141
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02655E, Paper

Hawraa S. Al-Buthabhak, Karrar Al-Ameed, Yu Yu, Alexandre N. Sobolev, Stephen A. Moggach, Hani Al-Salami, Vito Ferro, Murray V. Baker
AuI/AuIII complexes of triazolyl functionalized imidazolium salts were synthesised. AuI complexes reacted with SOCl2 to form AuIII species which were reduced in DMSO and converted into chelating AuIII complexes after treatment with silver nitrate.
